resources.string: Your AI assistant can use OsmAnd · %1$s
Lets an AI assistant on your computer (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor…) use OsmAnd on this phone: show places, plan routes, start navigation.
Works with the phone locked. A notification shows while the connector is on.
No notification. The connector stops when you leave this screen.
Keep this screen open: the assistant can use OsmAnd only while it is on.
This OsmAnd version has no permission request. Update OsmAnd.
OsmAnd asks what the assistant may do: map, search, navigation, favorites, tracks. You can change it later in OsmAnd › Menu › Plugins.
Keeps working when the router gives the phone a new address. Needs Python 3 on the computer.
